relations.statement: The runtime render body is a deterministic derivative of the CT monkey scan: segmented (25 bones) -> repaired+decimated (ratio 0.7020263287954351, <= 500,000-tri cap, 499,976 tris) -> standing_body.obj; standing_body.glb is a byte-identical boot conversion; ghost_standing.obj is composed from the same committed CT previews. This is a RENDER derivation only; it confers no mass or physics identity.

The training body is bound to the CT render body ONLY by the declared geometric fit v3 (LBS, 13 groups, 249,743 verts mapped) used to render the 302-tick walk on the real CT body. A rendering coupling, NOT a physics identity: the walker's rigid mass is 10.038 kg while the rendered creature's membrane physics default is 13824.5 kg; the two numbers are distinct lineages and are never interchanged (D-W04).

The forearm/paddle packet's source model is the FreeMusco Chimanoid (fictional human-based character, 56.88 kg). All packet geometry/fitting (U-STR, paddle, palm proxies, Buffy transported assembly) derives from that fictional model; the packet's R1 falsifier fired on exactly the attempt to read macaque anatomy out of it.

The forearm/paddle packet is ANALYSIS-ONLY ('Nothing here executes anything'); its transported assembly mass (17.039978509953905 kg) is declared owned and counted 0.0 with readiness false. It is not the play body in any way, and its source is not even a macaque. Decisions memo: the material/assembly branch stays conditional and must not change the walking runbook, training body, seeds, numerical bars or certificate.
The Buffy transported assembly (17.04 kg lineage) never feeds the 10.038 kg walker or any acceptance math; produce_inputs enforces counts_toward_component_mass=false on every transported claim.

Same name ('macaque'-like), not the same body: the Chimanoid is a fictional human-based character; the CT monkey is a real Macaca mulatta (USNM 497136-3). No species-specific macaque claim can be transferred between them (USTR R1 correction).

The playable trunk asset's geometry is derived from the training body's Oku numbers: height 1.158 m = standing_height_bound 0.901 (leg 0.419 + HAT 0.482) + forelimb chain 0.257 (upperarm 0.125 + forearm 0.132); radius 0.037 m = Oku foot length 0.074 / 2; weight_N 98.439153 cited in the derivation. The scene explicitly cites the 10.038 kg pin - an explicit, declared relation.

The runtime body (CT-derived render + membrane physics) is the creature placed in the campaign-authored clearing (F01 declaration, seed 4598321) with the F03 trunk; scene data is AGPL-3.0 campaign-authored, separate from the training gait scene.

The training body is the body simulated in the pinned gait scene f6844eeae3dc87170a572ccdeedf326a6cac4f73d1448941808bd8b25a8db342 (regenerated byte-identically by gait_scene.py; walk anchors stdout 8c537cdb..., 302 ticks, ledger 30.970714 J). The gait scene and the playable clearing are DIFFERENT scenes with different pinned identities.
